_help: Expected cable wiring. Pins: H1..H40 = RPi 40-pin header (RPi numbering), T1.1..T3.6 = TELEM1..3 JST-GH pin 1..6.
Every pin NOT listed in a net must be unconnected. Nets may have more than 2 pins.
any_of: pins that are common on the Pi. A net entry naming a group (e.g. PI_GND) passes on ANY pin of that group.
leds: which JST pin each of the 9 wire LEDs (D1..D9) reports, in board order.
PLACEHOLDER MAP - confirm against your cable drawing, or plug in a known-good cable and hold the button 3 s (learn).
